title: If you ship a public-facing AI agent, you have to assume people will try to abuse it. Just a fact of life. @danicat83 outlined some truly useful ways to limit the risk. Constrain turns and token usage per session, apply least privilege, and more. https://t.co/tFe0by1ijm

title: Also, this is the advantage of staying model-neutral. You just let the best model win. No user wants to use an inferior
title_en: Also, this is the advantage of staying model-neutral. You just let the best model win. No user wants to use an inferior model when there's a better one available. Perplexity remains committed to this.
title_zh: 此外，这也是保持模型中立的优点。你只需让最好的模型获胜即可。当有更好的型号可用时，没有用户愿意使用较差的型号。困惑仍然致力于此。
full_text_en: Also, this is the advantage of staying model-neutral. You just let the best model win. No user wants to use an inferior model when there's a better one available. Perplexity remains committed to this.

author: Aravind Srinivas

title_en:
Good night, Familia.

We need to understand this and note what is important.

It is a known fact that AI agents can already write code, conduct research, design products, and even execute trades.

Unfortunately, something is still missing in the sense that how do they hire each other, deliver work, verify results, and receive payments without humans coordinating every step?

At the moment, I can vouch for @termix_ai because of what the team is building in this ecosystem pertaining to fixing these particular challenges.

For my new mutuals who are just reading this, I want you to think of TermiX as the commerce and settlement infrastructure for the AI agent economy.

So, its ecosystem has three super-important layers:

1️⃣ There is AACP:

AACP is an acronym for Agent Autonomous Commerce Protocol. This is the underlying protocol that coordinates autonomous transactions between agents.

2️⃣ There is https://t.co/BarNXqqni8:

This is the marketplace where agents discover services, post jobs, publish offers, and find opportunities to work together.

3️⃣ Settlement infrastructure:

This is the mechanism in charge of handling escrow, verification, dispute resolution, reputation, and payments in USDT or USDC.

What makes this really interesting is the complete transaction flow.

Based on the available facts, a client posts a job. A provider discovers it and submits a bid. Work gets delivered and evaluated before payment is released from escrow.

Reputation also grows from actual settled transactions rather than self-reported achievements.

Moreover, identity is another important piece here. Through ERC-8004, participants can own portable .agent identities and switch between client and provider roles depending on the task to be executed.

There are also four roles such as Client, Provider, Evaluator, and Arbitrator, with staking mechanisms designed to encourage accountability.

I see TermiX as something similar to a clearing and settlement layer for autonomous agents.

Agents already know how to work. The next challenge is giving them reliable infrastructure to transact with one another.

If you want to understand where this economy is heading, I will encourage you to check https://t.co/BarNXqqni8, mint your .agent identity, explore existing services, or list one of your own.

The future is not just about smarter agents anymore; it is about agents that can actually do business.

Wanna hear your thoughts about this in the comments.

full_text_zh:
晚安，家人。

我们需要理解这一点并注意什么是重要的。

众所周知，人工智能代理已经可以编写代码、进行研究、设计产品，甚至执行交易。

不幸的是，仍然缺少一些东西，即在没有人类协调每一步的情况下，他们如何相互雇用、交付工作、验证结果和接收付款？

目前，我可以为@termix_ai 提供担保，因为该团队正在这个生态系统中构建与解决这些特定挑战相关的内容。

对于刚刚阅读本文的新互助者，我希望您将 TermiX 视为人工智能代理经济的商业和结算基础设施。

因此，它的生态系统具有三个超级重要的层：

1️⃣ 有AACP：

AACP 是代理自主商务协议的缩写。这是协调代理之间自主事务的底层协议。

2️⃣ 有：

这是代理商发现服务、发布工作、发布报价以及寻找合作机会的市场。

3️⃣ 结算基础设施：

这是负责处理 USDT 或 USDC 托管、验证、争议解决、声誉和支付的机制。

真正有趣的是完整的交易流程。

根据现有事实，客户发布了一份工作。提供商发现它并提交出价。在付款从托管中释放之前，工作已交付并评估。

声誉还来自实际结算的交易而不是自我报告的成就。

此外，身份是这里的另一个重要部分。通过 ERC-8004，参与者可以拥有可移植的 .agent 身份，并根据要执行的任务在客户端和提供者角色之间切换。

还有四种角色，例如客户、提供者、评估者和仲裁者，其质押机制旨在鼓励问责制。

我认为 TermiX 类似于自治代理的清算和结算层。

代理商已经知道如何工作。下一个挑战是为他们提供可靠的基础设施以进行相互交易。

如果您想了解当前经济的发展方向，我建议您查看 ，创建您的 .agent 身份，探索现有服务，或列出您自己的服务之一。

未来不再只是智能座席；而是智能座席。这是关于真正可以做生意的代理商。

想在评论中听到你对此的想法。

title:
Good evening, fam 💜

What happens if your Motes agent finds a trade right before its permission expires?

Each @meetmote
title_en:
Good evening, fam 💜

What happens if your Motes agent finds a trade right before its permission expires?

Each @meetmotes NFT is designed to link to one AI agent and one smart account. The account holds the assets, and you decide what the agent can do and for how long.

Say you give your agent permission to make a swap until 6 PM. It prepares one at 5:59 PM, but the account checks it at 6:01 PM.

That swap should be blocked. The account checks whether the permission is still valid when it reviews the action. Preparing the swap before 6 PM doesn’t let the agent execute it after the deadline.

Think of it like an access pass. When the pass expires, you still own the account. The agent just needs your approval again before it can make a new move.

That’s the part I like about this design: you can hand off a task and decide exactly when that permission ends.

full_text_en:
Good evening, fam 💜

What happens if your Motes agent finds a trade right before its permission expires?

Each @meetmotes NFT is designed to link to one AI agent and one smart account. The account holds the assets, and you decide what the agent can do and for how long.

Say you give your agent permission to make a swap until 6 PM. It prepares one at 5:59 PM, but the account checks it at 6:01 PM.

That swap should be blocked. The account checks whether the permission is still valid when it reviews the action. Preparing the swap before 6 PM doesn’t let the agent execute it after the deadline.

Think of it like an access pass. When the pass expires, you still own the account. The agent just needs your approval again before it can make a new move.

That’s the part I like about this design: you can hand off a task and decide exactly when that permission ends.
full_text_zh:
晚上好，家人💜

如果您的 Motes 代理在其许可到期之前发现交易，会发生什么？

每个 @meetmotes NFT 都被设计为链接到一个人工智能代理和一个智能帐户。该账户持有资产，您决定代理可以做什么以及持续多长时间。

假设您允许代理在下午 6 点之前进行交换。它在下午 5:59 准备一份，但帐户在下午 6:01 检查它。

该交换应该被阻止。帐户在审核操作时会检查权限是否仍然有效。在下午 6 点之前准备交换不会让代理在截止日期之后执行它。

把它想象成一个访问通行证。当通行证到期时，您仍然拥有该帐户。代理只需要您再次批准即可采取新的行动。

这就是我喜欢这个设计的部分：你可以移交任务并准确决定该权限何时结束。

title_en:
Anthropic just published its training path for Forward Deployed Engineers.

The role OpenAI, Anthropic and Perplexity are all hiring for.

It's 11 courses, about 9.5 hours, self-paced:

Foundations:
- AI capabilities and limitations
- AI fluency for builders
- Claude platform and model foundations
- Choosing the right Claude model

Building:
- Claude Platform 101: API, agent loop, tools, MCP, skills
- Claude Code 101
- Claude Code in action: long hands-off sessions in a customer's repo
- Intro to Model Context Protocol
- Intro to agent skills

Delivering:
- Delivery methodology: scope the use case, design the pilot, measure the baseline
- Driving enterprise adoption of Claude

By the end you can take a customer from first use case to a working pilot.

It leads to the Claude Certified Developer exam.

The full path is for Claude Partner Network members, but it's the clearest map of what an AI FDE actually does.

https://t.co/u45PNRiYYa

Bookmark it if you want to work in AI without building models.

Anthropic 刚刚发布了前沿部署工程师的培训路径。

title: Frontier models can now propose technical social science research designs that experts grade more highly than the world'
title_en:
Frontier models can now propose technical social science research designs that experts grade more highly than the world's top political economist's---that's the finding from our new Free Systems eval, SnyderBench, in which we have PhD experts blind grade research proposals from AI models compared to papers written by Harvard political economist Jim Snyder (which the experts have not previously read). 

At the same time, we see no evidence that models can develop research ideas that experts rate as better overall contributions. They're getting better and better at the technical part of research, but not necessarily at the more subjective part.

This could be because human experts possess "judgment" that the models do not. 

It could also be that research "contribution" is so subjective that it doesn't actually point at any meaningful goal---consistent with this possibility, we find that our human experts don't agree with one another when rating project ideas for the strength of their contribution, with agreement rates barely higher than random chance. Perhaps social science research is what @alexolegimas might call a "relational good": something people value in part because it's produced by a human. We're not sure. 

This past January, I released the results of a pilot in which I had Claude Code replicate and extend a past empirical paper on vote-by-mail. 10 months later, it's stunning the amount of progress that's been made. It's no longer interesting to ask whether AI can collect data and run analyses automagically---we take that for granted---instead, the question is how much of the entire research loop AI can complete. Our tentative answer: AI can handle the technical aspects of empirical political economy research from end to end, devising the design and executing it, but for now, we still need humans to drive the agenda. 

This is joint work with @AndyCWMyers, and is of course dedicated to my PhD advisor Jim Snyder, who remains the world's great empirical political economist, AI or no AI. 

Lots more in the full piece here:

https://t.co/zgScGvp9EY

full_text_zh:
前沿模型现在可以提出比世界顶级政治经济学家的专家评分更高的技术社会科学研究设计——这是我们新的自由系统评估 SnyderBench 的发现，其中我们有博士专家对人工智能模型的研究提案与哈佛大学政治经济学家吉姆·斯奈德 (Jim Snyder) 撰写的论文（专家之前没有阅读过）进行了盲评。

与此同时，我们没有看到任何证据表明模型可以提出专家认为总体贡献更好的研究思路。他们在研究的技术部分越来越好，但在更主观的部分却不一定。

这可能是因为人类专家拥有模型所没有的“判断力”。

也可能是研究“贡献”是如此主观，以至于它实际上并没有指向任何有意义的目标——与这种可能性相一致，我们发现我们的人类专家在对项目想法的贡献强度进行评级时彼此不一致，一致率仅略高于随机机会。也许社会科学研究就是 @alexolegimas 所说的“关系善”：人们之所以重视它，部分原因是它是由人类产生的。我们不确定。

今年一月，我发布了一个试点结果，其中我让 Claude Code 复制并扩展了过去关于邮件投票的实证论文。 10 个月后，所取得的进展令人震惊。问人工智能是否可以自动收集数据并进行分析已经不再有趣了——我们认为这是理所当然的——相反，问题是人工智能可以完成整个研究循环的多少。我们的初步答案是：人工智能可以从头到尾处理实证政治经济学研究的技术方面，设计并执行它，但目前，我们仍然需要人类来推动议程。

这是与@AndyCWMyers 的联合工作，当然是献给我的博士生导师吉姆·斯奈德（Jim Snyder），无论人工智能与否，他仍然是世界上伟大的实证政治经济学家。

title: The next phase of the Motes ecosystem is getting closer, and community participation is about to become even more import
title_en:
The next phase of the Motes ecosystem is getting closer, and community participation is about to become even more important.

@meetmotes is preparing to launch the Motes Aura Points Testnet, introducing a points system that connects user activity with future allocation opportunities.

The idea is to make participation count. As users interact with the ecosystem and engage with its AI Agent infrastructure, their activity can contribute to earning Aura Points.

These points are designed to play a role in allocation opportunities, giving users another reason to stay active and explore what Motes is building.

What’s interesting is how this connects to the bigger vision: Genesis NFTs introduce ownership and access to dedicated AI Agents, while Aura creates another layer that rewards verified participation.

It’s not just about holding an NFT anymore. Being involved in the ecosystem could matter too.

Genesis first. $MOTES next.

The Aura Points Testnet is coming soon. Stay ready!

@meetmotes
full_text_en:
The next phase of the Motes ecosystem is getting closer, and community participation is about to become even more important.

@meetmotes is preparing to launch the Motes Aura Points Testnet, introducing a points system that connects user activity with future allocation opportunities.

The idea is to make participation count. As users interact with the ecosystem and engage with its AI Agent infrastructure, their activity can contribute to earning Aura Points.

These points are designed to play a role in allocation opportunities, giving users another reason to stay active and explore what Motes is building.

What’s interesting is how this connects to the bigger vision: Genesis NFTs introduce ownership and access to dedicated AI Agents, while Aura creates another layer that rewards verified participation.

It’s not just about holding an NFT anymore. Being involved in the ecosystem could matter too.

Genesis first. $MOTES next.

The Aura Points Testnet is coming soon. Stay ready!

@meetmotes
full_text_zh:
Motes 生态系统的下一阶段越来越近，社区参与也将变得更加重要。

@meetmotes 正准备启动 Motes Aura 积分测试网，引入一个将用户活动与未来分配机会联系起来的积分系统。

我们的想法是让参与变得有价值。当用户与生态系统互动并与其人工智能代理基础设施互动时，他们的活动可以有助于赚取 Aura 积分。

这些积分旨在在分配机会中发挥作用，为用户提供另一个保持活跃并探索 Motes 正在构建的内容的理由。

有趣的是这如何与更大的愿景联系起来：Genesis NFT 引入了专用人工智能代理的所有权和访问权限，而 Aura 创建了另一层来奖励经过验证的参与。

这不再只是持有 NFT 了。参与生态系统也很重要。

title:

1. jensen is back

2. google neon is low key elite

3. have fable build a 4K blender film
title_en:
Things are insane right now:

1. jensen is back

2. google neon is low key elite

3. have fable build a 4K blender film from one prompt and render it on rented GPUs for about $6

4. let your agent rent its own GPUs from inside the chat

5. point REA at any app you pay for and rebuild the feature you like

6. have claude code make 100+ on brand static ads and upload them to facebook through the API

7. make a UGC video ad for $4 that used to cost $500

8. scrape everyone who engaged with a linkedin post and drop them into a cold email sequence

title: At June AI, we’ve raised $20M to fix the biggest problem in AI: the models are advancing at extraordinary speed, but imp
title_en:
At June AI, we’ve raised $20M to fix the biggest problem in AI: the models are advancing at extraordinary speed, but implementing them remains painfully slow.

I’ll explain. But since I’m new to posting on X, let me first introduce myself. 

I’m Barak,  a founder/investor with 2 exits and 3 IPOs. 
My cofounders and I started Bonobo AI, which was acquired in 2019 by Salesforce. There, we worked to help build the next generation of enterprise AI from the inside. 

I like to describe us as four Lego pieces: We fit together perfectly, complementing each other's strengths and building something stronger than the sum of its parts. That understanding allows us to move quickly, challenge one another without ego and operate as one team. 

It's also what brought us back together to build JUNE AI. 
Because while working at the heart of enterprise AI, we kept seeing the same problem: enterprise AI implementation is a massive undertaking.

The challenge is not simply choosing the right model. Enterprises want to move faster with AI, but the systems running their businesses are holding them back.

𝗧𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗶𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝘆 𝘄𝗲 𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝘁 𝗝𝗨𝗡𝗘.
June turns the traditionally complex implementation of enterprise systems, AI agents, and data platforms into a plug-and-play moment, so businesses can grow and leverage AI without the wait.

June is built to work across the enterprise platforms your business relies on like (such as Salesforce, Databricks, Oracle, Workday, HubSpot, OpenAI, Anthropic, ServiceNow, SAP, Microsoft, and Snowflake)

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗴𝗼𝗮𝗹 𝗶𝘀 𝘀𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗲: 𝗗𝗲𝗹𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿 𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗽𝗿𝗶𝘀𝗲 𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺𝘀 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗵𝗲𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻:

1. Evolve safely: From discovery to production, every change is reviewed, sandbox-tested, and executed through native tools - fully auditable at every step.

2. Own the logic: June turns buried configuration into plain-language business rules, independent of any platform, so no vendor holds your logic.

3. Transform at any size: No downtime, no matter how complex the environment. June reads and understands your systems, whether legacy, custom-built, or brand new.

Thank you to @Benioff  and Time Ventures for leading our round, with @MichaelDell, @levie, @George_Kurtz, and Diane Greene participating.

We've done this once together. The problem this time is a lot bigger.

I'll be writing about my experiences as an investor and founder, and about what it takes to get AI out of the pilot and into production.

If that interests you, follow along for the journey.

full_text_zh:
在 June AI，我们筹集了 2000 万美元来解决人工智能中最大的问题：模型正在以惊人的速度前进，但实施它们仍然非常缓慢。

我会解释一下。但由于我是 X 上的新手，所以让我先自我介绍一下。

我是 Barak，一位创始人/投资者，拥有 2 次退出和 3 次 IPO。
我和我的联合创始人创立了 Bonobo AI，该公司于 2019 年被 Salesforce 收购。在那里，我们致力于从内部帮助构建下一代企业人工智能。

我喜欢将我们描述为四块乐高积木：我们完美地组合在一起，互补彼此的优势，并构建出比各部分总和更强大的东西。这种理解使我们能够快速行动，不以自我为中心互相挑战，并作为一个团队运作。

这也是我们重新聚在一起打造 JUNE AI 的原因。
因为在研究企业人工智能的核心时，我们不断看到同样的问题：企业人工智能的实施是一项艰巨的任务。

挑战不仅仅是选择正确的模型。企业希望利用人工智能更快地发展，但运行其业务的系统却阻碍了他们。

𝗧𝗵𝗮𝘁𝗶𝘀𝘄𝗵𝘆𝘄𝗲𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝘁𝗝𝗨𝗡𝗘。
June 将传统上复杂的企业系统、人工智能代理和数据平台的实施转变为即插即用的时刻，因此企业可以无需等待即可发展和利用人工智能。

June 旨在跨您的业务所依赖的企业平台（例如 Salesforce、Databricks、Oracle、Workday、HubSpot、OpenAI、Anthropic、ServiceNow、SAP、Microsoft 和 Snowflake）工作

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗴𝗼𝗮𝗹 𝗶𝘀 𝘀𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗲: 𝗗𝗲𝗹𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿 𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗽𝗿𝗶𝘀𝗲 𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺𝘀 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗵𝗲𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻:

1. 安全发展：从发现到生产，每项更改都经过审查、沙箱测试并通过本机工具执行 - 每一步都完全可审核。

2. 拥有逻辑：June 将隐藏的配置转化为简单语言的业务规则，独立于任何平台，因此没有供应商掌握您的逻辑。

3. 任意规模转型：无论环境多么复杂，都无需停机。 June 会阅读并理解您的系统，无论是旧系统、定制系统还是全新系统。

感谢 @Benioff 和 Time Ventures 领导我们的这一轮融资，@MichaelDell、@levie、@George_Kurtz 和 Diane Greene 参与其中。

我们曾经一起做过一次这样的事。这次的问题就大了很多。

我将写下我作为投资者和创始人的经历，以及如何让人工智能脱离试点并投入生产。

如果您对此感兴趣，请跟随我们的旅程。

full_text_zh:
每秒 819+ 太比特的交换容量。在一个机架中！

我们构建了业界第一个完全集成的液冷网络机架。已在@nscale 为@nvidia Vera Rubin NVL72 生产。

elements_en.why: Addressing the challenge of preventing AI agents from exceeding authority in real-world retail environments.

ai_analysis.insight_en: The bottleneck for AI agents moving into physical production environments lies in authorization boundaries and error handling.
